significance: The Divya Desam of Anbil village near Tiruchirappalli, where Vishnu reclines as Sundararajan; it is praised in the Prabandham by Tirumalisai Alvar and counted among the reclining-Vishnu shrines of the south.
story: The sage Suthapa, cursed by Durvasa to live as a frog, is said to have been restored to his form here by Vishnu as Sundararajan.
